bedsit.name: Bedsit
bedsit.description: A single room in Whitechapel. The boiler makes a sound like someone clearing their throat. No storage to speak of.
bedsit.particulars: An incredibly cosy, fully integrated living space in vibrant Whitechapel, where bed, kitchen and bathroom enjoy an unusually close working relationship. Characterful boiler with a voice of its own. Viewing essential, as the photographer could not fit the room in.

studio.name: Studio
studio.description: One room in Stepney with a kitchen along the wall. The door locks and the key is yours. No spare room.
studio.particulars: A bright, open-plan residence in up-and-coming Stepney, the kitchen thoughtfully arranged along one wall so you can cook without leaving bed. Secure entry: the door locks. Ideal for the discerning professional who owns very little and intends to keep it that way.

flat.name: Flat
flat.description: Two rooms above a nail bar in Hackney. Neighbours ask no questions. One spare room.
flat.particulars: A generous two-room apartment in the heart of Hackney's thriving beauty quarter, the nail bar below supplying ambient fragrance at no extra cost. Famously incurious neighbours. Bonus second room, suitable as a study, a workshop or somewhere to put the problem.

townhouse.name: Townhouse
townhouse.description: Three floors, Bethnal Green. Previous tenant left in a hurry. Three spare rooms.
townhouse.particulars: A handsome three-storey period home in sought-after Bethnal Green, offered with vacant possession following the previous occupant's swift and unplanned departure. Some original features, some original stains. Chain-free, in that nobody is coming back for it.

safehouse.name: Safehouse
safehouse.description: Off-grid property, no registered occupant. Not technically yours, but no one is arguing. Five spare rooms.
safehouse.particulars: A rare opportunity to acquire a truly discreet off-grid residence, unknown to the Land Registry, the council and, it is hoped, everyone else. Deceptively spacious. Utilities arranged privately. Title is best described as a matter of confidence.

compound.name: Compound
compound.description: Gated property, East London. Eight rooms. People who matter know you live here.
compound.particulars: A statement gated estate for the East London buyer who has arrived and would like people to notice from a safe distance. Perimeter wall, controlled access, a driveway long enough to see visitors coming. The kind of address that ends conversations.

mansion.name: Mansion & Grounds
mansion.description: Grounds, staff quarters, a gate. Twelve rooms. Plato would have something to say about this.
mansion.particulars: A landmark residence with rolling grounds, staff quarters and a gate that opens only for the right people. Twelve reception-grade rooms, each large enough to lose a guest in. Philosopher-kings may find it modest; nobody else will.

lock.name: Reinforced Lock
lock.description: Slows down anyone trying the front door. Not much, but something.

cameras.name: CCTV
cameras.description: Four cameras, monitored by an app that sometimes works.

reinforcedDoor.name: Reinforced Door
reinforcedDoor.description: Steel-core. Would require a vehicle to breach, which draws attention.

alarm.name: Alarm System
alarm.description: Monitored alarm. Response time: nine minutes. Make of that what you will.

guard.name: Hired Guard
guard.description: Someone on site. Expensive. Asks fewer questions than you might expect.

ward.name: Orichalchum Ward
ward.description: James installed it. Doesn't explain what it does. It works.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.description: Bench, tools, decent lighting. Slightly increases crafting success chance.

homeGym.name: Home Gym
homeGym.description: Increases max HP and physical attack. It's just a pull-up bar and some kettlebells, but it helps.

library.name: Library
library.description: Reference books, field notes. Stacks with the workshop bonus.

safeRoom.name: Safe Room
safeRoom.description: Halves the amount stolen in a raid. Panic room logic.

ops.name: Operations Room
ops.description: Desk, screens, maps. Staff it with a contact to run Sales — sourcing offers and chasing the deliveries you delegate to them.

veinStation.name: Vein Cultivation Station
veinStation.description: An assigned contact holds your marked veins at whatever growth target you set — pruning back the ones running high, cultivating the ones falling behind. Yield lands in your inventory automatically.

lab.name: Improved Lab
lab.description: Professional setup. Set stock thresholds per recipe and an assigned contact will craft to meet them each day, using their skill and improving over time. James approved of it, which is as close to a compliment as he gets.
